_comment: Row 341. Five exact-once regressions restore the demonstrated false READY states at their independent decision points: optional generation, unverified route provenance, read-back failure not affecting the verdict, npm-ci failure demoted to WARN, and SPA build/read-back omitted. The band retains healthy controls for both deliverables. The separate transform-control battery applies the byte-identical transforms while running only an unrelated collection/import-safe gate; all five must ESCAPE.
subject: cloud provisioning READY requires measured GUI-parity and SPA artifacts

mutants.label: M1 demote failed GUI-parity generation back to optional
M2 accept any parsed route source as live application evidence
M3 report failed inventory read-back without failing READY
M4 demote npm dependency installation failure back to WARN
mutants.old:
if ! ( cd frontend && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund ); then
  echo "FATAL: frontend dependency installation failed"
  exit 1
fi
mutants.new: ( cd frontend && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund ) || echo "WARN: frontend deps failed"

mutants.label: M5 omit the SPA build and artifact read-back from recovery
mutants.old:
if ! ( cd frontend && npm run build ); then
  echo "FATAL: frontend SPA build failed"
  exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f frontend/dist/index.html ]; then
  echo "FATAL: npm run build exited 0 but frontend/dist/index.html is absent"
  exit 1
fi
echo "frontend bundle: frontend/dist/index.html present"
